items.title: House in Yakami / enter-archi
items.summary: House in Yakami explores how architecture can respond to the landscape through bodily experience, rather than simply consuming its beauty as a view. The site is located in Yakami, Onan Town , Shimane Prefecture, surrounded by the Chugoku Mountains.

items.summary: Casa Cuenca is a ten-room boutique hotel located in the Condesa neighborhood of Mexico City.

items.title: The House of Courtyards / Studio VDGA
items.summary: Set in the city of gold, Dubai , this villa was one of the most challenging projects considering the diverse architectural languages that the city follows. Be it the towering skyscrapers, extremely modern boxed structures, or ornate villas, the city sees a lot in spatial expression.

items.title: U-shaped store / MANERA
items.summary: U-shaped Store is a children's store designed by MANERA atelier. The project explores the relationship between retail space, scenography, and architecture, proposing a flexible environment organized around a central void.

items.title: Scrapped marine rope recast as stools that rock like buoys
items.summary: Rotterdam studio The New Raw has conceived stools from discarded rope salvaged at the city's harbour, which have been nominated for a Dezeen Award. The post Scrapped marine rope recast as stools that rock like buoys appeared first on Dezeen .

items.title: KOI Restaurant / SOA Architekti
items.summary: The restaurant in Košice occupies a corner building in the historic city centre, in a space that previously housed a clothing or furniture store. The business is run by a father and son.

items.title: Em-Estudio lines Mexico City bar with walls of books
items.summary: The vintage bookstores of Mexico City's Roma neighbourhood influenced the interiors of this basement bar, designed by local outfit Em-Estudio. The post Em-Estudio lines Mexico City bar with walls of books appeared first on Dezeen .

items.title: DamDam House / Studio SMA + Ground Architects
items.summary: DamDam is a compact house for a couple, their twins, and two cats, designed with solid exterior walls to ensure privacy on a small site surrounded by taller buildings.

items.title: Virtual Studio at the Cidade das TIC, A Coruña Arms Factory / Diaz y Diaz Architects
items.summary: In the former Weapons Factory of A Coruña , the Virtual Studio translates an essential duality into architecture: a hermetic box designed to create digital worlds versus an open volume that dialogues with the landscape and the industrial memory of the site.

items.title: O'Sullivan Skoufoglou Architects creates "quiet yet present" garden studio in London
items.summary: A low brick base anchors the timber structure of this pared-back garden studio, which O'Sullivan Skoufoglou Architects created as a workspace for a creative couple in Highbury. The post O'Sullivan Skoufoglou Architects creates "quiet yet present" garden studio in London appeared first on Dezeen .

items.title: Sunnyside Studios / Gluck+
items.summary: Sunnyside Studios rethinks the soundstage typology for a city where land can't spread horizontally. Studio campuses are typically conceived as backlots: individual soundstage boxes, each its own building, linked by golf carts and an interior street network. That model depends on land New York City doesn't have.

items.title: Alonakia House / React Architects
items.summary: Situated on a steep west-facing slope in Antiparos, the house overlooks the open Aegean and the long horizon of the setting sun. Its design begins with the condition of the site: a rugged terrain in which building is inseparable from the act of shaping the ground.

items.title: Planned Overflow: How Singapore Balances Floods, Canals, and Public Space
items.summary: At Bishan–Ang Mo Kio Park in Singapore , a river does not occupy a fixed boundary. Under ordinary conditions, water moves through a naturalized channel bordered by grass, planting, and paths that bring visitors close to the river.
